text:
Amy (CEO): Quick weekly check-in — high level: we need to tighten cost + reliability posture while keeping momentum on Private GA. Key asks below. :wave:

Jordan (VP Eng): Appreciate the heads-up. On reliability — SLOs and rollout plan are ready, will share dashboard links after standup.

Priya (Head of Product): Product asks: make sure Private GA includes the restricted telemetry opt-out for regulated customers. That’s blocking some final sign-offs.

Marco (Finance): Cost target this quarter: reduce hosted inference unit cost by 12% vs last quarter. Need concrete levers by next Wed (batching, quantization, tiered routing).

Leah (Security): Compliance note: SOC docs are in final review. Any last-minute data retention exceptions must be flagged by EOD Fri. Also add an audit event for "private-deploy-accept" action.

Amy (CEO): Summary of priorities for the week: 1) Private GA checklist complete (telemetry opt-out + KMS onboarding), 2) Cost playbook: 12% reduction plan + owner for each lever, 3) Reliability: reduce p99 tail latency incidents and finalize fallback policies.

Sam (SRE): Quick status — p99 tail improved after KV-cache fix, but we saw 2 regressions during the midnight batch window. Investigating root cause now.

Jordan (VP Eng): Action items — I’ll own rollout and fallback policy. Sam, can you capture the batch-window regression in a short incident note and tag infra? Use the incident template: ```/incident new "batch-window-p99-regression"```

Sam (SRE): Yep doing that now. Will include timeline + initial mitigation.

Priya (Head of Product): For Private GA gating: docs link for the telemetry opt-out and UI mockups are here: <https://confluence.redwood/PrivateGA/telemetry-optout>. Please review by tomorrow.

Marco (Finance): To help engineering prioritize — attach expected $ impact per lever (ballpark acceptable). If you need model-level estimates, I can run the unit-cost calc with usage curves.

Leah (Security): Note to eng: KMS integration checklist requires rotating test keys before production onboarding. I’ll send the checklist.

Amy (CEO): Timeline: Private GA launch window = next Thursday EOD. If any blockers that prevent patching telemetry or KMS, escalate to me + Jordan immediately.

Jordan (VP Eng): Understood. I’ll run a canary deployment tomorrow morning and post results. DeployBot: canary scheduled at 09:30 PT.

DeployBot: Canary deployment created by Jordan — build 2026.03.22-rlw-125. Monitoring hooks enabled.

Sam (SRE): Canary smoke: initial latencies look good, but we need to validate cold-start behavior with longer sequence lengths.

Priya (Head of Product): Also reminder: the Private GA release notes must explicitly call out limitations (no external integrations at GA). Draft due Wed COB.

Marco (Finance): One more ask from finance — please tag all perf experiments with the cost tag so we can attribute savings. Example tag: cost:batching.

Leah (Security): Compliance will need a short runbook for incident response on Private nodes. I’ll draft and circulate.

Amy (CEO): Final: thanks team. Two owners to call out: Jordan — rollout + fallback; Marco — cost-savings consolidation; Leah — compliance runbook. Weekly sync Friday 10:00 PT to review go/no-go. If you’re blocked, ping me. :rocket:

Jordan (VP Eng): Acknowledged. I’ll post a short follow-up thread with the canary results and explicit go/no-go checklist after the run.

Sam (SRE): Added the batch-window incident to #incidents and linked the draft mitigation. Will update before the sync.

Priya (Head of Product): Will finish the release notes draft by Wed and share for review.

Marco (Finance): I’ll drop a simple spreadsheet with lever owners and estimated delta by Tue EOD.

Leah (Security): Sending KMS and runbook checklists shortly.

Amy (CEO): Thanks everyone — let’s keep execution tight this week. Short wins + one clear decision point at Friday sync. :handshake:
